en: Our showdown comes... with the night.
I look forward to the sunset...
Hmph, fool. Do you think power like yours
could ever match mine?
To treat the landowner Daedalus's illness,
note: Seward monologue (attends Daedalus, writes to Van Helsing). Rows 7CC/7A0/780 are one page.

en: I came here to Medoekia, but...
a serious problem has come up.
Jonathan Harker, a patent agent,
came to me with a request...
And so I've come to hunt the vampire
that is lurking in this village.
It seems some in this village have already
been attacked by the vampire...
Medically, it can't be called an illness.
Yet the loss of blood, and the marks
on the neck...
This is surely the work of a vampire.
By day, I call at the villagers' homes,
and wherever the vampire is likely to appear,
I set up an altar...
This altar has the power to purify people
who have been turned into vampires.
The vampire is tougher than I'd thought.
A university professor and fellow doctor,
Professor Van Helsing...
I've written to him, asking for his help...
My letter should reach him any day now.
The vampire...
note: Harker. Vampire referred to as 'it' (gender not stated by Harker).

en: I'm the one who awakened it!
For now, I'm staying at the village church.
note: Shared: also printed before 47C + F8 in a second Harker page.

en: I'll become a vampire hunter
note: Shared line: followed by #460 in one page and by #F8 in another; both continuations start with 'and take responsibility'.

en: and take responsibility for this!
I've asked the renowned physician,
Dr. Jack Seward, for his help.
For the vampire hunt, I'm grateful to have
a dependable ally like him.
By day, I go around like this, setting out
the garlic and holly that vampires hate.
At night, when the vampire reveals itself,
I'll show no mercy...
note: Shared line: also follows #198 ('Anyone who gets in my way, whoever it is,') per the bytecode.

en: The fiend and its lackeys, wolves and bats...
I'll shoot them all dead.
If not for all this, by now I would
have been engaged back in London.
Her name is Miss Rose, a young noblewoman
hailed as the greatest beauty in London...
But... my fate has already
been sealed.
Until I slay the vampire as a hunter,
I'll know no days of peace...
What exactly is your purpose here?
note: Player asks the hunter (polite form, no Chris/Duran branch).

en: That's none of your business.
Anyone who gets in my way, whoever it is,
note: Bytecode prints #350 'I'll show no mercy...' on the next line, completing this sentence.

en: Hard as it may be to believe...
there is a vampire in this village.
And that vampire was awakened
by none other than me...
